title: Aarav's Sky Adventure
description: Aarav, a curious 10-year-old boy, discovers he can fly and experiences the wonders of the sky.

cast.name: Aarav
cast.style: blue t-shirt, brown shorts, messy hair, bright eyes

cast.name: Sky Breeze
cast.style: glowing trails, playful, swirling around Aarav

scenes.visual_prompt: (wide) Aarav, 10 yrs, energetic kid, blue t-shirt, brown shorts, lifted off ground, Sky Breeze swirling around, soft clouds in background, magical storybook style
scenes.narration: आरव को महसूस हुआ कि वह हवा में उड़ सकता है।
scenes.subtitle: The Lift-Off
scenes.motion_prompt: Aarav floating upward, wind swirls around him

scenes.visual_prompt: (wide) Aarav, 10 yrs, energetic kid, blue t-shirt, brown shorts flying midair, Sky Breeze around, forest below, sunny sky, storybook magical style

scenes.subtitle: Above the Forest
scenes.motion_prompt: Aarav flying over trees, wind trailing behind

scenes.visual_prompt: (medium) Aarav, 10 yrs, energetic kid, blue t-shirt, brown shorts floating, Cloud Friends smiling and surrounding him, sunny sky background, storybook magical style

scenes.subtitle: Cloud Play
scenes.motion_prompt: Aarav jumping between clouds, clouds reacting playfully

scenes.visual_prompt: (medium) Aarav, 10 yrs, energetic kid, blue t-shirt, brown shorts flying, Sky Breeze swirls, motion lines showing air currents, storybook magical style

scenes.subtitle: Dancing with Wind
scenes.motion_prompt: Aarav gliding through swirling wind currents

scenes.description: Aarav watches sunset from the sky
scenes.visual_prompt: (wide) Aarav, 10 yrs, energetic kid, blue t-shirt, brown shorts floating peacefully, Sky Breeze softly glowing, sun setting in background, storybook magical style
scenes.narration: सूरज डूबते समय, आरव ने आसमान से दुनिया को देखा और मंत्रमुग्ध हो गया।
